overall_impression_without_labels: A woman pauses while removing a protective sheet from an old photographic glass plate. A lighthouse and coast in its image sit beneath an overwhelmingly tall curved masonry wall. The scene reads as intimate archival discovery with restrained unease.

broad_genre.evidence: The fragile record, tiny lighthouse/immense wall scale comparison, weathered architecture and attentive parted-lip response support cosmic-horror associations.
broad_genre.limits: Indifference, actual ancient age, nonhuman authorship and supernatural cause remain interpretations. The image is quieter and less frightening than the written dread; regular arches replace the requested incompatible opening angles.

situation_and_relationship.evidence: The near hand visibly pinches the interleaving sheet, the face attends to the plate and the lower coast is revealed; this connects action and evidence. The far gripping hand has no visible wrist/forearm route back to the woman, so its actual ownership and reach cannot be fully checked.

reference_appearance.evidence: The oval face, large dark-brown eyes, softly shaped lips, chin-length dark bob and fine fringe strongly retain the reference appearance in a new orientation. This establishes visual resemblance, not personal identity.

controls_perception_before_labels: The portrayal feels warm and naturally attractive but primarily attentive and unsettled; clothing and material do not dominate as an erotic focus. The only impossible implication sits within the archived huge structure.

control_comparison.observation: The subtle human warmth and restrained archive direction fit the intended supporting expression; this is a reviewer reading rather than a calibrated intensity or user preference.

comparative_preference.reason: No independently rendered baseline image exists. Prompt alternatives and one result cannot prove an artistic improvement over baseline pixels.

native_body_observation: The near hand and forearm have coherent visible continuity and tissue contact. The glass rests in a padded rack. The far fingers are plausible at the edge, but their wrist and arm connection are concealed; do not diagnose an extra limb or assign a passed whole-body route from that uncertainty.
